turns.t: Hi, doctor. It's my toe, and I'm a bit squeamish about all this, sorry. It's an ingrown toenail, I think. It's really sore.
No need to apologise. Which toe?
The big toe on my left foot, the outside edge. It's red, swollen, and a bit yellowy at the corner.
How long has it been like that?
A week. It got much worse in the last three days. It throbs at night.
Any fever, or shivering?
No fever. I've felt fine, otherwise.
Is there pus, or has it been bleeding?
Some pus, yes, a little. But no blood.
Any numbness in the toe? ~
No, I can feel everything, unfortunately. ~
Have you tried anything yourself? ~
I soaked it in salt water, which helped a little, and I stopped wearing my work boots. ~
Good. Let me look. Can you take your sock off? ~
Oh dear. Okay.
The outer edge of the nail is digging into the skin, there's redness and swelling around it, and a little pus at the corner, but the redness doesn't spread up the toe.
Is it infected? ~
Yes, it's mildly infected, an infected ingrown toenail.
Will you have to cut it? ~
Not today. I'd like to start with antibiotics, flucloxacillin, 500 mg, four times a day, for seven days. Have you had it before?
I've taken it once, for a cut, and it was fine. ~
Good. Take it on an empty stomach, half an hour before food.
Okay. ~
And I'd like to send a swab of the pus to the lab, to be sure the antibiotic's right.
Will it hurt? ~
Only a touch, it's a quick dab.
Done? ~
Done. Now, soak the toe in warm salty water for ten minutes, twice a day, and keep it clean and dry.
Right. And my shoes? ~
Open shoes or roomy ones, and don't trim the nail down at the corners. ~
I was trimming it at the corners. ~
That's often the cause. Cut it straight across. ~
I'll remember. ~
If you get a fever, redness spreading up your foot, or the pain gets worse, see us the same day.
I will. Thank you. ~

physical_examination.finding: outer edge of the nail is digging into the skin
physical_examination.normalized_finding: Ingrown nail edge with paronychia and pus

clinical_actions.description: Start Flucloxacillin 500 mg four times a day
Take flucloxacillin on an empty stomach half an hour before food
Soak toe in warm salty water twice a day, keep clean and dry; roomy shoes and cut nails straight across
See same day if fever, spreading redness or worse pain
